text: Teaching Objectives This program majoring in Western Economics. The program is designed to equip students with advanced skills in economic theory and econometric. The emphasis is on development of students’ analytically skills, in particular their ability to identify key questions and to use theoretical and empirical tools to answer them. Internship Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, visits to companies, and career consultation. Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree of Economics by Shenyang University FutureCareer The graduates can work in the International trade transportation, insurance, customs clearance etc agencies, specialized foreign-trade corporations, and import and export department's of foreign-owned enterprises.
